title: Final slashed amount could be much lower than expected
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, lower final slash amount could require further slashing, causing remaining stakers to lose more  **Likelihood:** Medium, happens when slashed  ## Description  `slashAndStartAuction()` allows governance to slash a percentage of the `StakedToken` to settle protocol deficits. A slash percentage is provided as a parameter and derived from the absolute value required to cover the deficits.
